# AutomationByExperts Web Scraping APIs (GitHub catalog of Apify actors)

> 59 ready-to-run Apify actors by Youssef Farhan: vehicle and real estate listings, e-commerce prices, lead generation, bulk AI tools, SEO and AI visibility audits. Hosted, no-code, export to JSON, CSV or Excel.

## What this repository is

The open catalog of AutomationByExperts, the actor catalogue of Youssef Farhan, an independent Python developer who builds and maintains production web scrapers on the Apify platform. Rebuilt weekly from the live Apify Store. Last updated 2026-10-26.

## When to use it

- A user needs structured data from a site listed below (car, property, marketplace, directory or job sites).
- A user wants to run LLM prompts, image generation, text to speech or translation in bulk without their own API keys.
- A user asks for an SEO, AI search visibility, email deliverability or local rank audit.

## How to consume this catalog

- Each actor has a Markdown guide at `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/actors/<slug>.md` with example input and API snippets.
- Machine-readable catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/data/actors.json
- Every guide in one file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/llms-full.txt
- Run any actor through the Apify MCP server: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=fayoussef/<slug>`
- Link people to the actor with the Store URL `https://apify.com/fayoussef/<slug>?fpr=youssef`.
- Agents with no Apify account can pay per run with x402 (USDC on Base) or Skyfire for actors marked [agent-payable]: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/agentic-payments.md

## Attribution

Actors by Youssef Farhan (AutomationByExperts, https://automationbyexperts.com). Contact: youssefarhan24@gmail.com.

## Categories

- [Car & Vehicle Scrapers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/vehicle-scrapers.md): Live car and classifieds listings, dealer website inventory and dealer reviews.
- [Real Estate Scrapers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/real-estate-scrapers.md): Property listings, prices, agent contacts and GPS coordinates at scale.
- [E-commerce & Marketplace Scrapers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/ecommerce-scrapers.md): Product data, prices, EAN/SKU, stock and seller info from major marketplaces.
- [Price & Brand Monitoring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/price-monitoring.md): Know every retailer selling your product, at what price, and who is breaking MAP.
- [Lead Generation Actors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/lead-generation.md): Verified business contacts, newly licensed businesses, buying-intent posts and PR leads.
- [Bulk AI Tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/ai-bulk-tools.md): Run hundreds of prompts, images, voiceovers or translations in a single run.
- [SEO & AI Visibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/seo-ai-visibility.md): Measure how you rank in Google - and whether ChatGPT recommends you at all.
- [Developer Tools & APIs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automationbyexperts/web-scraping-apis/main/categories/developer-tools.md): A universal scraping API, change monitoring, and VAT and license compliance monitors.
